contract.artillery: One launch WAV per actual rocket shot. Do not play the three-shot offline sample as an event cue.
contract.start: Launch/hit contact begins at file start; no pre-roll.
contract.playback: Single event id+generation dedup; user gesture unlock; gain budget, cancellation on pause/seek/reset/hidden/dispose owned by viewer.
contract.headroom: Each cue peak <=.85. Overlaps need additional mixer gain/headroom; sample sequence uses .25 per cue.
contract.timing: Bound to copied viewerContract revision/hash. Events are independent short files; offline 6-second sequences demonstrate the exact contract schedule.

rights: Procedural originals + source project v5 asset provenance per cue; no external samples/API/music/voice.

clock.seek_policy: cancel all audio; resume schedules future events only

audio_delivery.map_format: cue-map.json with cues array entries {branch, variant, phase, path, duration, peak, rms}; path relative to map directory
audio_delivery.normalization: paired basic/enhanced comparable RMS or loudness, peak below -1dBFS, finite PCM and no clipping; document source and layering
audio_delivery.consumer_behavior: Only one comparison side audio plays at a time. User gesture unlock, mute/volume, source cancellation on pause/seek/reset/branch change/hidden/end, no infinite loops.
